name: Screen
description: Capture screenshots of the host screen.
author: PAI

capabilities.description: Take a screenshot. Uses grim (Wayland) or scrot/import (X11). Requires PAI_SCREEN_CONSENT=1 in the agent env.
capabilities.confirmationReason: Capturing screenshots can be sensitive. Please confirm that you want to take a screenshot.

outputPath.description: Absolute path for the PNG. Defaults to ~/Pictures/PAI/screen_<timestamp>.png
